messages:
frances (Billing Ops): FYI two customers reported today’s invoices with inconsistent PDFs: one PDF shows usage $0 while ledger/lines are correct, and in one case the same invoice_id was emitted twice with different content. sample snippet below. :mag:

frances (Billing Ops): Redacted sample PDF text:
```
Invoice: 2025-08-INV-7722
Customer: nova-tech
PDF variant A:
 - Reserved capacity: $700
 - Usage (tokens): $0    <-- missing
 - Tax: $56
 Total: $756

PDF variant B:
 - Reserved capacity: $700
 - Usage (tokens): $280
 - Tax: $74
 Total: $1,054
Ledger charge: $1,054
```

omar (FinOps): invoices-bot, any duplicate alerts for this batch?

invoices-bot: ALERT: duplicate invoice_id detected: 2025-08-INV-7722 (batch invoice_run_2025_08_31) - count=2.

lucy (Support): Customer is confused; they received both PDFs and opened a ticket. They were charged once but want clarity.

nina (Payments): Pausing invoice email sender for the August run. We'll also pause auto-capture for reported customers until we confirm.

frances (Billing Ops): Quick checks: invoice_lines and ledger match the correct amounts. invoice_pdfs table shows two records for 2025-08-INV-7722. Renderer log: "WARN render_line(): template absent for 'usage_details' when feature_flag compact_view=true on retry"

omar (FinOps): Possible cause: renderer retry path created a second PDF and, under the compact_view flag, skipped usage lines. We should make render idempotent and ensure it reads canonical invoice_lines.

eng-billing: Confirmed: job runner retried pdf-render step after a timeout and pdf-render writes without checking for existing pdf row. Also found feature_flag compact_view toggled in last renderer deploy.

deploy-bot: Deploy event: invoice-renderer v2.9.0 -> prod at 1859988000 by ci/pipeline.

frances (Billing Ops): Proposed immediate actions: 1) keep email sends paused 2) mark affected invoice_pdfs rows status=investigating 3) dedupe PDFs (retain the PDF whose totals match invoice_lines) 4) re-render any missing/correct PDFs with renderer pinned to v2.8.x or after hotfix 5) resend corrected PDFs with a short apology note stating charged amount unchanged.

nina (Payments): Paused sends and set gateway holds for the customers who reported the issue. We'll only resume after QA signoff.

omar (FinOps): I'll open FIN-2025-999, attach logs and affected invoice list, and request eng-billing prioritize a hotfix to make pdf-render idempotent and add an alert when invoice_pdfs count>1 per invoice_id.

lucy (Support): I'll prepare the customer message template: short apology, confirm charged amount unchanged, corrected PDF will be emailed within 24 hours. Send me the affected list when ready.

frances (Billing Ops): FIN-2025-999 created and assigned to eng-billing. Will update this thread once dedupe and re-render are complete. :white_check_mark:
